versions.subject: Create powershell_invoke_obfuscation_clip+.yml
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventID: 4104
selection_2:
    - ScriptBlockText|re: '.+clip(.exe|)(\s|)&&.*clipboard]::\(\s\\\"\{\d\}.+'
selection_3:
    EventID: 4103
selection_4:
    - Payload|re: '.+clip(.exe|)(\s|)&&.*clipboard]::\(\s\\\"\{\d\}.+'
condition: ( selection_1 and selection_2 ) or ( selection_3 and selection_4 )
versions.spl: | rex field=ScriptBlockText "(?<ScriptBlockTextMatch>.+clip(.exe|)(\\s|)&&.*clipboard]::\\(\\s\\\\\\\"\\{\\d\\}.+)" | eval ScriptBlockTextCondition=if(isnotnull(ScriptBlockTextMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=Payload "(?<PayloadMatch>.+clip(.exe|)(\\s|)&&.*clipboard]::\\(\\s\\\\\\\"\\{\\d\\}.+)" | eval PayloadCondition=if(isnotnull(PayloadMatch), "true", "false") | search (EventID=4104 ScriptBlockTextCondition="true") OR (EventID=4103 PayloadCondition="true")
